newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore builds S$131 mln undersea cable tunnel.
newsitem.headline: Singapore builds S$131 mln undersea cable tunnel.

text.p: Singapore will spend about S$131 million to build an undersea cable tunnel off the western part of the island in Tuas Bay, Singapore Power said in a statement on Wednesday.
The state-owned power utility said a contract had been given to Obayashi Corp for the design and construction of the tunnel, terminal buildings and a land cable tunnel.
The whole project is expected to be completed by July 1998.

"The installation of the 400 kV cable in the undersea cable tunnel at the western tip of the island is necessary to link Tuas Power Station, which will be coming on stream in 1999, to the electricity transmission network," said the statement.
